ui_animal_hint: Walk up to the animal to collect products, breed it or move it.

ui_guide_feed: Place feed troughs at the ranch and keep them topped up with feed bags. Hungry animals eat from them automatically.
ui_guide_water: Place water troughs and refill them with a filled water bucket. Thirsty animals drink from them automatically.
ui_guide_products: Healthy, well-fed adult animals produce milk, wool or fertiliser over time. Walk up to the animal to collect it.
ui_guide_breeding: A healthy male and female of the same species that are old enough can breed. Pregnant animals give birth when the time is up.
ui_guide_herding: Use Start Herding to move groups of animals, for example to a sale point.
ui_guide_selling: Herd cattle to a sale point to sell them, or sell pigs, cows and sheep from the Market tab. Prime-age animals sell for the most.
